meta.name: Recipe: Closed-Form Particles
meta.description: A beat-triggered spark burst built as closed-form trajectories of (index, age) per contract section 6.1 — no per-particle simulation. rand(i + beat_count * 1000) re-rolls each spark's direction and speed on every beat; a launch-time var (lastBeatT) records when the current burst started; position is a pure function of the spark's random direction and its age (t - lastBeatT). Sparks fade out as they fly, and the whole burst only appears when a beat fires, so silence stays calm.
meta.author: ViewMusic authoring manual

element.x: cos(rand(i + beat_count * 1000) * tau) * settings.spread * (0.4 + 0.6 * rand(i + 100 + beat_count * 1000)) * clamp((t - lastBeatT) / settings.life, 0, 1) / aspect
element.y: sin(rand(i + beat_count * 1000) * tau) * settings.spread * (0.4 + 0.6 * rand(i + 100 + beat_count * 1000)) * clamp((t - lastBeatT) / settings.life, 0, 1)

color.a: (1 - clamp((t - lastBeatT) / settings.life, 0, 1)) * step(0, settings.life - (t - lastBeatT))
